creative.name: Three-game threat drill
creative.headline:
ONE THREAT
THREE GAMES
creative.body: Notice it · Test a reply · Review the move
creative.caption: An original three-game drill for free A.I. chess practice. Notice one threat, test a reply, then review your decision. Draft for review
creative.measure: Saves per reach at 72 hours and seven days after approved publication; compare like channel and format windows
sequence: Ask what the last move attacked in the constructed position
Reveal the knight on f6 attacking e4 and one legal defence
Invite three no-stake practice games and one move review per game
